title_en: Evaluating zero-shot geometric cryptic-pocket detectors on the official CryptoBench receptor-only benchmark
title_zh: 在官方 CryptoBench 仅受体基准上评估零样本几何隐蔽口袋检测器
scientific_question_en: How well do deterministic, training-free geometric detectors recover cryptic binding-site residues from apo receptors on the official CryptoBench MMseqs2 10% cluster-disjoint test fold?

primary_benchmark.name: CryptoBench official test fold
primary_benchmark.split: MMseqs2 clustering at 10% sequence identity; cluster-disjoint test fold
primary_benchmark.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over structures, 10000 resamples, 95% CI

primary_claim_en: Deterministic geometric detectors, with no training and no fitted parameters, obtain a quantified and reproducible margin over a residue-level chance baseline on the official CryptoBench test fold.

B.name: finite_field_allele_conditioning_ablation
B.note: Algebraic negative control only; carries no chemical, binding or efficacy content.

truth_boundary_en: The primary claim is confined to receptor-only cryptic-residue classification on the official CryptoBench test fold. Appendix A (ESR1) and Appendix B (allele-conditioning ablation) are excluded from the primary claim and from every generalization statement. Candidate evidence lives in the companion repository and is not part of this paper's claim.
